sloka: पितृव्यौ चापि सन्दृश्य समरे सन्निषूदितौ।युद्धोन्मत्तं च मत्तं च भ्रातरौ राक्षसर्षभौ ।। ६.७१.२ ।।
transliteration: pitṛvyau cāpi sandṛśya samare sanniṣūditau।yuddhonmattaṁ ca mattaṁ ca bhrātarau rākṣasarṣabhau ।। 6.71.2 ।।

translations.english: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.
